Create one new single character in a square 1:1 canvas. Composition: standing waist-up adult at 3/4 frontal camera, entire head visible with a small margin above it, torso and hands visible, fills approximately the same relative area as a single reference cell. Plain near-black/deep bottle-green backdrop, restrained brass warm light and a cool teal rim. This is a static portrait, not a sprite or animation sheet. No text, borders, logos, watermark, duplicate people, extra limbs, cropped head or floating body parts. Subject: MYSTERY, an elegant unreadable adult traveler in a tailored charcoal coat and brimmed dark hat. Dark leather gloves naturally hold a sealed gold envelope at the lower chest. Face partly in the hat's shade, but anatomically complete and coherent with visible eyes and a distinct nose and mouth. Calm enigmatic expression. Real fabric texture, subtle gold wax seal without any lettering.
